30. He further submits that for enforcement of the agreement time was fixed for 90 days and time is the essence of the contract. But the plaintiff took no steps for execution and registration of the sale deed within the fixed period of 90 days. He further submits that the defendant denied the subsequent payment, even if the defendant No.1 accept any amount after the period of time that does not mean the extension of period of time, if the time was extended, it should have mentioned in the contract rather the defendant No-1 denied the subsequent payment and acceptance of the amount after the said period of time and that the plaintiff took no steps to prove subsequent payment and burden lies upon him who claims that he has made payment. He further submits that in a suit for specific performance of contract all the ingredients of the contract should be considered strictly in accordance with law. But both the Courts below failed to consider the same thereby committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. In support of his contention, he cited the case of lqbal Hossain Talukder (Md.) -Vs- Joynal Abedin Talukder and 76 others reported in 55 DLR 604. 

 49. Such deposition is vague deposition when and how rest consideration money was offered to the defendant was not stated and as such both the Courts below misread and misconstrued the evidence on record after the expiry period of time he is not bound to accept and that defendant No.1 denied the acceptance of any amount after the expiry of the period. The burden of proof lies upon him who claims that he made payment but no step was taken by the plaintiff to proof the signature and writings by any expert nor the courts below examined those signature and writings thus I find that though the judgment and decree of both the Courts below are concurrent but there are misreading of evidence. 

 54. It further appears that the defendant in his written statement denied the subsequent payment after expiry of the period of 90 days an amount of Tk.1,20,000/- which was alleged to have been made after expiry of the period of time .The burden shifted upon the plaintiff to prove that he paid Tk.1,20,000/- to the defendant by witnesses or by, examining the writing and signature of the defendant No 1. But no such steps were taken by the plaintiff or  by the trial Court and as such it can safely been said that no such payment was made after expiry of the period and as such time is the essence of the contract and that the plaintiff failed to comply his part of contract by paying the rest amount within the period of time and by depositing the amount as cost of stamp to the authority by treasury challan and as such the plaintiff failed to prove his willingness to get the property registered and as such both the Courts below failed to consider the case in its proper perspective thereby committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice.
